scope: Wild-type template site context for the MET kinase domain. The geometric and ligand features describe the experimental wild-type inhibitor complex; they do not measure mutation-induced structural change. Masking of an engineered template residue does not remove possible wider effects of the engineered residue on the template.

reference.source: UniProt REST fasta, fetched 2026-10-27 (sequence version 4, 1390 residues)
reference.substitutions: 19 per position (the 20 standard residues minus the wild-type residue)

chain_rule: the chain with the most residues having a Cα with a blank insertion code and a residue number in 1055-1349; ties go to the alphabetically first chain
ligand_rule: exactly one HETATM residue with the entry's inhibitor component in the chosen chain; zero or several raises an error; waters, ions, crystallization additives and other components are ignored
model_rule: first MODEL only; one conformer per residue: each atom takes its blank location, else 'A'; an atom with neither is missing; residues with any altloc atom are flagged (not masked)

residue_rules.missing: no residue with this number in the chosen chain
residue_rules.insertion_code: any residue number carrying an insertion-coded residue is excluded (conservative)
residue_rules.engineered: residue name differs from the reference residue at that number (substitution or non-standard residue such as MSE)
residue_rules.incomplete_side_chain: a heavy atom expected for the residue type is absent after the conformer rule (flag; masks ligand-context features of that residue only)
residue_rules.chain_break: consecutive residue numbers both present with Cα-Cα distance above 4.2 A

propagation: a nine-Cα window (positions p-4..p+4) is masked, for the angular block and the distance block alike, if any residue in it is missing, engineered, insertion-coded, lacks a Cα or a chain break lies inside it; the ligand-context block of position p is masked if residue p is missing, engineered, insertion-coded or has an incomplete side chain; no value is imputed

definitions.vol: residue volume in solution, A^3, Zamyatnin 1972 Prog Biophys Mol Biol 24:107-123 (values checked against the GPM tabulation of that table)
definitions.kd: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, J Mol Biol 157:105-132 (1982) (values checked against ExPASy ProtScale)
definitions.charge: formal side-chain charge near pH 7: Asp -1, Glu -1, Lys +1, Arg +1, all others 0 (His 0 by convention)

definitions.L_min_heavy_dist_A: minimum distance, A, between any heavy atom of the wild-type residue and any heavy atom of the ligand
definitions.L_min_sidechain_dist_A: minimum distance, A, between side-chain heavy atoms (CB onward) and ligand heavy atoms; missing with reason no_side_chain for glycine
definitions.L_n_contact_atoms_4p5: number of heavy atoms of the wild-type residue within 4.5 A of any ligand heavy atom
definitions.L_ca_min_dist_A: distance, A, from the Cα to the nearest ligand heavy atom

definitions.kappa: turning angle, radians in [0, pi], at the seven interior vertices of the nine-Cα window (core compute_ca_features; checked against the numpy reference within 1e-4)
definitions.tau: signed torsion between consecutive osculating planes at the six hinges, represented as sin and cos (circular quantity); bond lengths are not included

definitions.d_i_j: Euclidean distance, A, between window Cα i and j (36 values) from exactly the nine coordinates used by T
